-2-  NC: 2025:KHC:25211  CRL.P No. 9871 of 2024 HC-KAR  THIS CRL.P. IS FILED U/S 482 OF CR.P.C., (FILED U/S 528 BNNS) PRAYING TO QUASH THE ORDER DATED 25.04.2024 PASSED IN P.C.NO.28/2024 BY THE HONBLE JMFC (III COURT) MANGALURU TAKING COGNIZANCE FOR THE OFFENCE P/US/ 406, 417 AND 420 OF IPC AND REGISTERING THE CASE AS C.C.NO.1073/2024, AGAINST THE ACCUSED /
PETITIONER HEREIN.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
MR . JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

In this petition, the petitioner seeks the following reliefs:
" Wherefore, the Petitioners herein most respectfully pray that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to :
a.

To set aside the order, dated 25.04.2024 produced at annexure -'B' passed in P.C.No.28/2024, by the Hon'ble JMFC (III Court) Mangaluru, taking cognizance for the offences punishable U/Sec. 406, 417, and 420 of IPC, and registering the case as C.C.No.1073/2024, against NC: 2025:KHC:25211 HC-KAR the accused/Petitioner herein, in the interest of justice and equity."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo, stating that the petition may be disposed of as withdrawn in the interest of justice and equity.
The memo is placed on record.

3. The memo reads as under:
"MEMO "It is humbly submitted that this Hon'ble Court may pleased to permit to withdraw the above case, in the interest of Justice, as petitioner instructed to withdraw the above case. "
